frame: primary: the loadable rows of the val-2000 file (1,525 of 2,000 records; load_rows drops rows with missing probe caches or empty phrases) - the deployed configuration, SAM caches present. Secondary: the held-out train tuning frame (no SAM caches) in secondary_heldout_frame.

tests.name: T2 determinism: re-analysis is exact; greedy model answers are near-reproducible
tests.method: (a) two independent in-process evaluations of the val-frame metrics on the same saved records/caches; (b) an identical-prompt re-query of 12 cached prompts (measured on held-out prompts; the reproduction property is population-independent) in a throwaway cache namespace with the same prompt text, greedy decoding, batch size 2 vs the original extraction's batch 6

greedy_requery_diffs.phrase: sofa on right side next to desk

measurements.requery_interpretation: the metric re-analysis is bit-identical (deltas exactly 0). The frozen VLM's greedy answers are NOT bit-reproducible across batch compositions: 5/12 boxes and 3/12 raw strings match exactly; the mismatches are (i) last-digit rounding (two cases), (ii) the known batched-decode empty-string artifact that re-answers correctly at batch size 1 (two cases), and (iii) one box-vs-none answer flip. Downstream impact is bounded by the primary T1 (paraphrased boxes change 0/608 val-frame predictions) and this frame's T3 (jitter deltas ~0 with SAM present).

tests.status: pass (re-analysis exact; model-side variance measured and bounded)

tests.name: T4 detector-source swap (LLaVA+det0 -> det0-only)
tests.method: pure re-analysis: the pool picks restricted to the GroundingDINO det0 box

tests.name: T3 box jitter (deterministic scale/shift perturbations)
tests.method: every cached box (LLaVA and det0) scaled about its center or shifted by 5% of the image; the shipped rule recomputed on a seeded 300-row held-out subsample
tests.liveness_note: the substitution path is live (T1's drop-control changes 13/608 predictions; T4's detector swap moves cIoU by +0.02), but with the box-prompted SAM masks present the union is dominated by them, so perturbing the boxes rarely changes it - the measured jitter deltas are ~0.

tests.name: T1 prompt-template paraphrase
tests.method: a paraphrased box prompt re-queried with the same frozen VLM on the terms of 60 held-out targeted rows; box IoU against the cached answers, and the shipped rule recomputed on the sample with the paraphrased boxes substituted for the cached LLaVA boxes

population_verification.method: shipped rule re-composed for every held-out population row directly from the disk caches (LLaVA / GDINO / SAM), the paraphrased box substituted for the cached LLaVA box
population_verification.interpretation: the paraphrased prompt answers the same way where it answers at all, and even where the box differs the mask union does not change: the LLaVA-box picks are redundant with the det0 picks and the SAM masks (the aggressive control that drops every LLaVA box changes 13 of the same 608 predictions).
population_verification.denominators: 1,525 rows load from the 2,000-record file (load_rows drops rows with missing probe caches or empty phrases); 608 are non-abstaining; the sample block counts directly comparable (box, box) pairs among the 60 queried terms, the population block joins the paraphrase cache per (file, term).

secondary_heldout_frame.caveat: on the held-out tuning population the box-prompted SAM caches do not exist (the studies computed those masks live on GPU), so this frame runs the rule without SAM masks; its larger jitter/swap deltas reflect that configuration, not the deployed one
